name: Dysostosis with Brachydactyly with Extraskeletal Manifestations
aliases: Dysostosis with Brachydactyly and Extraskeletal Features

criteria.description: Presence of brachydactyly characterized by shortened digits due to abnormal bone development
Presence of extraskeletal abnormalities such as craniofacial dysmorphism, dental anomalies, or skin abnormalities
Radiographic evidence of dysostosis including abnormal bone morphology and ossification patterns
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant or recessive inheritance
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with dysostosis syndromes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of brachydactyly and extraskeletal manifestations with radiological evidence of dysostosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging and genetic testing when available.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Brachydactyly with shortened metacarpals and phalanges

searchTerms: unusual facial bone shape with flat midface

pathognomonic.symptomName: Dental anomalies including hypodontia and enamel hypoplasia
searchTerms: missing teeth or weak tooth enamel
dental problems like fewer teeth and enamel defects

common.symptomName: Short stature due to skeletal dysplasia
searchTerms: short height caused by bone growth disorders
below average stature due to skeletal issues
patches of darker or lighter skin
areas of skin with unusual pigmentation

common.symptomName: Delayed bone age on radiographic assessment
searchTerms: bones appear younger than actual age on X-ray
slow bone development seen on imaging
slight stiffness or tightness in joints

occasional.symptomName: Hearing impairment due to ossicular anomalies
searchTerms: hearing loss caused by ear bone abnormalities

occasional.symptomName: Mild intellectual disability or developmental delay

searchTerms: holes or defects in heart walls

occasional.symptomName: Respiratory complications secondary to thoracic cage abnormalities
searchTerms: breathing issues due to chest wall deformities
respiratory problems from rib cage abnormalities

rare.symptomName: Renal anomalies such as hypoplastic kidneys
Endocrine dysfunction such as growth hormone deficiency

laboratory: Possible mild endocrine hormone abnormalities if growth hormone deficiency present
imaging: Radiographs showing brachydactyly with shortened metacarpals and phalanges
Abnormal ossification patterns consistent with dysostosis
Possible thoracic cage deformities on chest X-ray
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes associated with bone development and dysostosis syndromes (specific gene not yet well defined)
other: Clinical examination revealing craniofacial dysmorphism and dental anomalies

distinguishingFeatures: Normal radiographic bone morphology outside digits
Distinct facial features including midface hypoplasia and hypertelorism

redFlags: Severe respiratory distress due to thoracic cage abnormalities
Progressive neurological impairment or developmental delay
Congenital cardiac defects requiring urgent intervention
references: Orphanet: Dysostosis with brachydactyly with extraskeletal manifestations, ORPHA:498454
Recent literature on skeletal dysplasias and brachydactyly phenotypes
